question: The Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in October 2022 has excluded which country from the grey list of global watchdog on terror financing and money laundering?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Financial Action Task Force (FATF)** in** October 2022** has **excluded Pakistan** from its** grey list** of countries under increased monitoring for **terror financing and money laundering.**
 
• Pakistan has been on the FATF's grey list since **June 2018.**
 
• However, the country has made significant progress in addressing the concerns raised by the FATF and has been** removed **from the grey list.
 
• The FATF is an inter-governmental body that sets** standards **and promotes effective implementation of** legal, regulatory, and operational measu**res for combating **money laundering, terrorist financing,** and other related threats to the integrity of the international financial system. 
 
• Countries that fail to meet these standards are put on the **FATF grey list** and subjected to increased monitoring and scrutiny.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bangladesh:**

 
 
• Bangladesh was **never** on the FATF grey list. However, it has been under the FATF's radar due to its financial system's vulnerabilities to **money laundering and terrorism financing.**
 
 
 
• **North Korea:**
 
 
• North Korea has been on the **FATF's blacklist since 2009** and has been subjected to strict sanctions due to its involvement in **money laundering and illicit activities. **
 
 
 
• **China: **
 
 
• **​**China has been on the **FATF's grey list since 2008** and has been making efforts to improve its** anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing system.**
